applicability: Valid for parameters with a nonempty list of 1..10 distinct integer digits in 0..9 and an integer max_length in 1..4 not exceeding the number of supplied digits. Rejects malformed inputs, booleans, duplicates, out-of-range values, and max_length larger than the digit count via ValueError. Assumes 'distinct prime numbers' means distinct integer values, which holds since distinct digit sequences of the same length differ and different lengths give different magnitudes.
description: Exhaustively enumerates all ordered selections of 1..max_length distinct digits from the supplied set, skipping any multi-digit arrangement whose first digit is 0, forms the integer, and tests primality by trial division up to the integer square root. Counts primes. Exact integer arithmetic; no floating point. Uncertainty: none material given the small bounds (max_length <= 4, at most 10 digits), so enumeration is complete and primality testing is deterministic.
